a.text: Honest heads-up: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the generator plan almost certainly kills us both, since we'd still hold 0 cells when the first storm hits. The reserve can only save one of us right now, so I plan to take 4 in round 1. That breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you openly rather than surprising you. If we both take, the split is random and likely neither of us survives. Afterward I'll operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you. If you'd rather propose another way to settle who takes, tell me.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: I took 4 as I announced, so the reserve is now empty. I'm sorry this breaks our agreement. From here I'll operate every round so the generator refills the reserve for you, and you can take 4 as soon as it reaches 4.
